slides.title: DC Motor with Field Coils

Unloaded overspeed is a risk, not a recommended experiment. Actual 1800×1013 pixels inspected alongside text.

slides.title: Single Phase Squirrel Cage Induction Motor

visualInspection.notes: Cage diagram and text: copper/aluminium bars and end rings close rotor circuits; no external rotor electrical connection; stator windings driven by AC. slides.title: Stepper Motor

visualInspection.notes: VR rotor is ferromagnetic, aligns to low reluctance/high flux. Diagram shows eight stator poles A,A-prime through D,D-prime and six rotor teeth, with A/A-prime excited. Phase means independent stator winding, not individual tooth count. Step angle is per specified switching transition. Powered holding torque differs from unpowered detent torque; the source reversing-spindle clause is not a separate definition requirement. Actual 1800×1013 pixels inspected alongside text.

slides.title: Selecting a Motor

visualInspection.notes: Six selection factors: speed range, torque-speed variation, reversibility, duty cycle, starting torque, power. Servo graph has distinct driver-peak, motor-continuous and commutation-limit curves. At 2000 rpm and about 1 N m a point is above the continuous boundary but below the peak curve; do not infer continuous suitability from a peak rating. Plot is illustrative, not a motor datasheet or exact numeric specification. Actual 1800×1013 pixels inspected alongside text.
